stages.title: Classify
stages.body: Identify the dominant tested mechanism before calculating.

stages.title: Extract
stages.body: Separate givens, unknowns, constraints and the requested output.

stages.title: Represent
stages.body: Choose equation, table, diagram, number line, grid or passage map.

stages.title: Select method
stages.body: Use the lightest valid method, not the most familiar one.

stages.title: Execute
stages.body: Keep units, domains, direction and assumptions visible.

stages.title: Verify
stages.body: Use plug-back, bounds, enumeration, reverse coding or passage support.

stages.title: Decide
stages.body: Answer, eliminate, park or leave according to evidence and time.

stages.title: Cross-family routing
stages.body: Send number, arithmetic, rate, algebra, logic and communication gaps to their owners.

stages.title: Mixed problems
stages.body: Decompose a question into ordered sub-mechanisms.

stages.title: Cognitive load
stages.body: Externalise information instead of holding it mentally.

stages.title: Time and risk
stages.body: Use three passes and positive-evidence elimination.

stages.title: Readiness loop
stages.body: Diagnose error type, remediate the owner and retest under time.
